decisions.reason: DOI 10.1007/s11837-020-04255-9 at cp 2054 sits in |url=https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1007/...pdf of a citation template. Guide 3.5 lists a publisher URL as a DOI form only when its path contains /doi/; this path does not, so the 'anything else: the identifier text' row applies and the quote starts at '10.1007' (the '.pdf' suffix is not part of the DOI). Role identifier_link fits a publisher URL inside url= pointing at the identifier. The identifier is in the window, so it is in scope and the engine's miss is an engine omission. Locked label stands (key already lower-case and valid).
